launcher_icon._doc: The launcher icon, generated from this declaration by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-launcher-icons.py (pattern + category colours + glyphs in 1_cicd/src/data/launcher-icons.json). Never edit the generated res files.

name: cloud-kg-store
description: Cloud KG Store (#1207) - the fleet's knowledge-graph store and browser, three sections on the bottom nav: Cloud (two rows of groups: Application = Binary, Web/Debug, MCP search tools, API Data and API Debug with GET and POST; Repo = Code, CGC, MCP search tools, API Semantic and GraphRAG; every page is backed by the fleet endpoints declared in ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints - c3-infra-api, cloud-me-api, c3-public-api, the two CGC MCP services and embeddings-api - and says plainly when an endpoint is missing or does not answer), Phone (the installed Android apps index through PackageManager: package, version, permissions and components) and Web (News, Media, Shopping, Real Estate, Jobs, Business, on the sources and parsers Cloud Search declares: its build.json::search is baked by reference and its plain-JVM search-core is linked by reference, nothing is copied). The assistant behind the top bar's AI icon is libs:ai's chat over the fleet agent gateway (mesh only); no token is held or read by this app for it (decisions-use guard D5), and the fleet bearer for the public fallback route is read from Cloud Account on use and never kept. Dark is the default theme (#336); English is the base language (#299).

android._doc_application_id: The fleet name with its separator dropped, as cloudcalc / cloudsearch.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: A_A0-Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A_A0-Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud SuperIntel.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph; settings.gradle iterates it. No `logic` lib is compiled in (lib-classes L4): the Store installs and updates this app, as it does Cloud Calc.

libs:devtools._doc_dir: Not linked in app/build.gradle: libs:core pulls it in with an `api` dependency, which makes this app a fleet mesh member with the debug API.

libs:crash._doc: #1122 libs:core `api`s this module (the default crash handler, the local crash sink and the generic crash screen); listed so settings.gradle resolves the path and the ship workflow's path triggers see it, not linked in the app's own gradle.

libs:fleetconfig-model._doc: #873 libs:core `api`s this module (the setup provider every app serves); listed so settings.gradle resolves the path.

libs:bottomnav._doc: #868 the fleet's NavDecl (ui.bottom_nav/ui.sections baked into BuildConfig), the top-bar scaffold's drawer and the scroll collapse, shared BY REFERENCE.

libs:ui-icons._doc: #1160 the nav icon catalog (name to ImageVector, tinted or brand): every nav glyph of every app, shared BY REFERENCE; libs:bottomnav depends on it.

libs:ai._doc: The fleet's AI chat (libs:ai): the page, the sessions drawer panel (new, rename, delete), the Markdown answers, the streaming and the shared contract. The backend is the fleet agent gateway (my-ai-api, mesh only; its address is baked as BuildConfig.AI_GATEWAY_URL by libs/ai/ai-gateway.gradle); no token is held or read here (decisions-use guard D5).

libs:model-catalogue._doc: libs:ai's `api` dependency: the shared agent descriptor (assets/agents/agents.json) its Agent picker lists, and the model catalogue. Listed so settings.gradle resolves the path.

libs:ui-nav-bars._doc: #1154 shared navigation and theme design, shared BY REFERENCE.

libs:theme-background._doc: #1154 shared navigation and theme design, shared BY REFERENCE.

search-core._doc: #1207 shared BY REFERENCE: Cloud Search's plain-JVM core (its build.json::search reader, the source parsers and the cache-backed query engine, the CGC and MCP protocol, the fleet endpoint routing). The Web pages and the Repo pages use it; nothing is copied. Its own suite and PIT run in cloud-search's CI (this app's unit task is scoped to :app).

tests._doc: Read by 1_cicd/dist/scripts/cloud-android-test-engine.sh, which the ship workflow runs before it builds.

unit._doc: SCOPED to :app on purpose (the browser's shape): an unscoped `gradle test` also runs libs:ai's and search-core's suites, and PIT on search-core with another app's build.json. debug, not release, so the task never configures the release signing config. The suite: the declaration kg.json against build.json::ui and Cloud Search's build.json::search, the fleet calls on a fake network (honest empty states), the installed-apps index, the web pages.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Cloud KG Store: three sections on the bottom nav, Cloud, Phone and Web, plus Ask (the assistant behind the AI icon at the top right, not on the bottom nav) and Settings behind the first row. Cloud is the section in `horizontal_two_rows` mode (libs:ui-nav-bars NavSectionLayout; the user may switch it to one row or the side menu in Configs): two groups on the first row, Application and Repo, each with its five pages on the second. Application: Binary (the fleet's binaries), Web/Debug (the apps' debug endpoints), MCP (search tools of the MCP services the apps declare), API Data and API Debug (GET and POST consoles on the fleet API services). Repo: Code (code search), CGC (the two code graph indexes), MCP (the CGC MCP services' search tools), API Semantic and API GraphRAG (the two CGC tools). Phone is the installed Android apps index. Web is News, Media, Shopping, Real Estate, Jobs and Business on Cloud Search's declared sources. The page ids ARE the keys of assets/kg/kg.json::pages (test-kg-store-app.sh and KgConfigTest hold them in step, both ways). Every icon is a libs:ui-icons name. The Profile icon at the top right of the first row opens extapp:cloud-account; the sessions drawer is the hamburger's.
